metadata.title: KeyTabTools
metadata.description: Cross-platform PowerShell utility for generating offline Kerberos keytab files. Supports RC4-HMAC, AES-128, and AES-256 encryption. Works on Windows, Linux, and macOS as an alternative to ktpass. Based on original work by Adam Burford.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$Password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
